messages:
lina (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm working on a tiny UX tip addition for the on-prem installer docs around KMS/HSM setup. Noticed several support cases where the HSM device node permissions block pkcs11 access.
sam (eng-ml): Nice, what do you want to add? a udev example? troubleshooting steps?
lina (docs): Exactly. Short udev rule + a fallback check during install that emits a helpful error (instead of the generic PKCS11 NULL). Want to include a code snippet and a 3-step remedial flow for operators.
maria (security): We should include a security note: don't recommend chmod 666 on /dev/hsm. Prefer udev rules that set group to "redwood-hsm" and mention auditd implications.
aaron (eng-platform): Agree with maria. Also include systemd unit drop-in example for the installer service so it waits for the device to be present. Small snippet like:
```
[Unit]
After=dev-hsm.device

[Service]
Restart=on-failure
```
jules (support): I've seen two customers hit this with SoftHSM on a VM where the device path changes after reboot. A quick /usr/local/bin/hsm-check script helped them. We can paste it in the troubleshooting section.
lina (docs): Sketching the doc patch: short intro, udev rule, systemd wait snippet, hsm-check script, and a recommended error message that the installer should surface. I'll open a PR in docs repo and tag reviewers. Anyone want to review wording before I PR?
sam (eng-ml): Happy to review. Also propose adding a small SDK snippet showing how the client detects PKCS11 errors and falls back to a clear user-facing message. Example:
```
try:
  client.load_pkcs11(module_path)
except PKCS11Error as e:
  raise InstallerError("HSM init failed: check device permissions and udev rules: https://redwood.docs/onprem/hsm-troubleshoot")
```
maria (security): I'll review but add a blurb on least privilege and reference our key-handling policy. @lina (docs) please ping me in PR.
lina (docs): Will do. Draft PR link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/7621 (work-in-progress). Please add quick comments inline. I'm planning to land by EOD if no blockers.
deploy-bot: lint results: docs/md-lint: 1 warning (line 42). Suggest running `./tools/lint-md --fix` before merge.
aaron (eng-platform): Also add a short note for air-gapped installs: include the PKCS11 module binary in the airgap bundle and verify path with `installer --verify-hsm /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so`.
jules (support): I'll prepare two canned responses for support: one for missing device node and one for permission mismatch. Send to me when PR is ready.
lina (docs): Thanks all — I'll incorporate feedback, add maria's security line, run the linter, and paste the final support snippets. Tagging reviewers: @sam, @maria, @aaron, @jules. End.
